note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Digital Realty ATH4, Ifestou 72-76 'Bota' BIOPA Koropi (GR) - fourth building on the Athens campus
entries.reason: The 7 September 2026 OPS-ADE modification (action 586011) notifies ATH4 with 6,800.04 kW IT, and the PPD decision lists ATH-4 among the existing buildings, but Digital Realty's Athens pages list only ATH1-ATH3 and the 2026-10-16 hold records an inauguration still expected in October or November. A notification is filed before operation starts, so it does not establish that ATH4 opened. The campus is a new site in this fragment, so only one project (ATH1-ATH3) can be added.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Digital Realty statement or government record that ATH4 has opened or entered service; then add it as a second project on curated:digital-realty-athens-koropi-ifestou-campus reusing that campus locator.

entries.candidate: Karatzi Kentra Dedomenon Monoprosopi A.E. 'Κέντρο Διαχείρισης Δεδομένων', position 'Varika' / 'Vasiliki Porta', Kryoneri, Municipality of Dionysos, East Attica (GR)
entries.reason: The Region of Attica (Regional Council) announcement of 14 September 2026 opens public consultation (14 September to 23 October 2026) on the EIA (MPE) for this data centre, category A2, group 12 no. 20, forwarded by the Decentralised Administration on 11 September; a Diavgeia metadata record of 21 October 2026 (ΡΑΟΤΩ93-ΥΓ4) shows the Municipality of Dionysos opinion on the same EIA, with total installed power rising to 39.1 MW from 19.5 MW. No source gives a parcel, coordinate or street address: the EIA documents sit in the Electronic Environmental Register for registered users only, and Diavgeia decision documents (/doc/) are robots-disallowed. A Dionysos building permit of 9 September 2026 (9ΤΒΞ46Ψ842-ΩΚΒ, new complex of data-centre buildings, 12.5 MW IT) may concern the same site but names no developer in its metadata.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible record giving the property (KAEK), coordinates or an address point for the Varika / Vasiliki Porta site, or a Karatzis publication locating it; then admit as announced from the 14 September 2026 EIA announcement, or as permitted if the 9 September building permit is shown to be this project and in effect.

entries.candidate: Megalopoli 1 and Megalopoli 2 data-centre buildings, 9.9 MW each (Municipality of Megalopoli, Arcadia) and GNWSIS DATA CENTER SOLUTIONS M.A.E. at 'Kampos', Leontari (GR)
entries.reason: Diavgeia metadata show two e-Adeies building permits issued on 2 October 2026 (Ψ7ΗΞ46Ψ842-ΑΔΥ and ΨΖΨΡ46Ψ842-2ΣΞ, 'Erection of data-centre building, 9.9 MW [Megalopoli 1/2]', municipality code 4004 = Megalopoli) and a Region of Peloponnese road access approval of 30 September 2026 (9ΧΠ8ΩΛ8-ΔΒΚ) for GNWSIS DATA CENTER SOLUTIONS M.A.E. at 'Kampos', Leontari. The permit documents, with owner, address and KAEK, are under Diavgeia /doc/ (robots-disallowed); no developer page or other locator was found, and the link between the permits and GNWSIS is not established.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible developer, municipal or regional record naming the Megalopoli permit holder and the plot (KAEK, coordinates or OPS-ADE notification); then admit as permitted on 2 October 2026 with that locator.

entries.candidate: Spata-Artemida data-centre building permit revisions (11 and 21 September 2026) and pre-approval for a new two-storey data-centre building (14 September 2026) (GR)
entries.reason: Diavgeia metadata (municipality code 4912 = Spata-Artemida) list a pre-approval and the third revision of a building permit for 'Erection of a Data Center' (minor changes to the MV substation studies), and a separate pre-approval for a new two-storey data-centre building. The documents are robots-disallowed and the metadata name no developer, so they cannot be tied to the existing Ten Brinke Spata record or to a new site. A permit revision is not a newer physical status for the under-construction Ten Brinke project.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible record identifying the permit holder and plot for each permit; a revision tied to Ten Brinke Spata would only be identity context.
